newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 9.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 10 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The issue of so-called 'trophy art' may raise problems for Russian President Boris Yeltsin at home with the country's parliament as well as during his visit to Germany which is due to start on April 17.
- A failed attempt to host 2004 Olympic Games in St Petersburg will cost Russian taxpayers 129 billion roubles.
- An International Monetary Fund (IMF) delegation is to arrive in Moscow on April 21 to continue talks on the payment of the delayed EFF tranches.
- World Bank president James Wolfensohn is due to arrive in Moscow tomorrow to talk about loans to Russia of up to $3 billion a year.
- Russia's Central Bank is expected to give foreigners equal rights on the GKO T-bills and OFZ government bonds market by the end of this year.
- In an effort to drive smuggled and bootleg alcohol out from the domestic market, the Russian Economy Ministry ordered an increase the minimum price of spririts by 37.5 percent as of April 15.
